Hero artwork sources
====================

- fas-background.jpg: FAS 4–11 catalog, page 1, upper cover photograph (also used by the 15–250 catalog).
- fas-small-product.png: FAS 4–11 catalog, page 2, compressor/receiver/dryer illustration.
- fas-large-product.png: FAS 15–250 catalog, page 2, FAS-30 illustration.
- fsg-background.jpg: FSG 45–185 catalog, page 1, quarry cover photograph.
- fsg-product.png: original FSG340 image and transparency mask embedded in the FSG cover.
- fasm-background.jpg: existing FASM catalog, page 1, compressor room photograph.

These are extracted/rendered catalog assets, not generated product depictions.
The FAS illustrations retain their original white page background; the hero uses CSS multiply blending.
Highlights are maintained in src/lib/heroCatalog.ts and refer to page 2 of each corresponding catalog.
FSL uses a shared industrial background and an availability placeholder until an approved catalog/product is supplied.
